article_title: 筋トレはゆっくり動かすほど効く？「下ろす動作」で見直したいこと

actual_reviewer.method: Separate visual reread after generation. Source, generated photo, three originals and all six 320/400px previews directly inspected.
actual_reviewer.observations: Direct visual reread: one woman in sage shirt practices an unweighted partial squat on the actual training floor. Knees/hips are naturally bent and both separated hands are plausible. Feet are outside the frame; contact is judged on the preceding unchanged pose and visible spatial integration, not directly visible feet. Rack/bar/cables/bench stay behind her; oxygen booth remains far left rear. No added dumbbells, trainer or relocated equipment. Static image cannot measure speed; the pose depicts controlled lowering practice.
actual_reviewer.score_interpretation: Scores and 65% attention share are reviewer estimates, not measurements or separate-model output. No separate agent or paid QC API. R2 feet are outside frame. R1 visible grounded pose was inspected but not accepted due to repeated full-body framing; R2 spatial integration judged from visible pose only. Static speed is not measurable.

plan.article_specific_directive: Customer rehearses a controlled unweighted squat descent on the actual open training floor. No dumbbell added. Manual alternative after the automatic dumbbell-driven source match had no eligible source; canonical registry and all recency rules preserved.
